cards.text: Jesus has just been arrested, and all of His disciples deserted Him and fled. The men who arrested Him lead Him away to the house of Caiaphas, the high priest. The scribes and elders are gathered there.

cards.question: Jesus is being led away to the high priest's house. What does Peter, one of the Twelve, do?

cards.text: He follows all the way to the high priest's courtyard, walks right in, and sits down with the guards. The GUARDS, friend!

cards.question: Peter sits down with the guards in the high priest's courtyard so he can see the outcome.

cards.text: Peter wants to see how this ends, just from way back, like watching a scary movie from the hallway. Inside, the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin are looking for false testimony against Jesus, so they can put Him to death.

cards.question: Many false witnesses come forward against Jesus, and the council finds the testimony it's looking for right away.

cards.text: A line of false witnesses out the door, and STILL nothing! Finally two men come forward and say Jesus claimed He's able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.
Friend, when the high priest gets up out of his seat, you know it just got serious. He asks Jesus, "Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?"

cards.question: The high priest wants Jesus to answer the charges against Him. What does Jesus do?
Then the high priest charges Jesus under oath by the living God to tell them if He is the ___, the Son of God.

cards.text: All that silence, and NOW Jesus speaks. "You have said it yourself," He answers, and He tells them all that from now on they will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.

cards.question: When he hears this, the high priest tears his clothes and declares that Jesus has ___.
The high priest says they don't need any more witnesses against Jesus. Why not?

answers.text: The witnesses have all gone home
Jesus has asked them for mercy

cards.question: The high priest asks the council what they think, and they answer that Jesus deserves to die.

cards.text: Then they spit in His face and strike Him, and others slap Him and say, "Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?" Read that one slow, friend.
Meanwhile, Peter's still sitting out in the courtyard, doing his very best impression of a chair. "You also were with Jesus the Galilean," a servant girl says, walking right up to him.

cards.question: In front of them all, what does Peter tell the servant girl?

answers.text: He doesn't know what she's talking about
He's proud to follow Jesus of Galilee
He's just a traveler passing through

cards.text: That's like your phone ringing in your pocket and you looking around going, "WHAT phone?" Then Peter moves out to the gateway.

cards.question: Out at the gateway, a second servant girl spots Peter and tells the people there that he was with Jesus of Nazareth.
Peter gets called out a second time. How does he deny it now?

cards.text: Peter says, "I do not know the man!" Not Jesus, friend. Just "the man."
After a little while, the people standing nearby walk up to Peter. "Surely you are one of them," they say, and I bet Peter's heart is pounding.

cards.question: The people standing nearby tell Peter that his ___ gives him away.
The third time, what does Peter begin to do as he tells them he doesn't know Jesus?

cards.text: And immediately, right on cue, a rooster crows.

cards.question: Peter remembers that Jesus said before the rooster crows, Peter would deny Him ___ times.
After Peter remembers what Jesus said, he goes back inside to find Jesus.

cards.text: Peter goes outside and weeps bitterly. Sit with that one for a minute, friend, because this story is still going.

findings.problem: Card 3 has just told the baker that Peter walks into the high priest's courtyard and sits down with the guards. The true or false statement repeats that almost word for word, so the only new piece it tests is 'to see the outcome.' Card 5 then opens by retelling that answer ('Peter wants to see how this ends'). The question is almost answered by its own setup, and the pair reads like a recap instead of moving the passage forward.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage.

findings.problem: 'Friend, when the high priest gets up out of his seat, you know it just got serious' reads like a nice dad being pleasant, not a real laugh. Stop 1's only real joke is the scary movie line on card 5. The trial is a solemn moment and Jesus can't be the target, but a line like this one, about the high priest's situation, could land a real laugh or be cut.

rule.text: When a moment can hold a real laugh without muddying a fact, he goes for it. If a line reads like a nice dad being pleasant, push it further.

findings.problem: The question says 'In front of them all,' but 'them' points to people the baker hasn't been told about. Card 1 mentions only Peter and the servant girl, and it isn't on screen anymore anyway. The question should say who is there, such as the people in the courtyard.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
